description: The Architecture Diagram Generator shall produce a single unified PlantUML diagram that renders the complete module/architecture view of a codegraph project. The generator shall query the codegraph Neo4j store for all modules/namespaces and their composition/dependency relationships, aggregate them into one coherent diagram, and emit valid PlantUML component-diagram syntax. The diagram shall use package notation for modules/namespaces, show key classes inside each package (medium detail level), render directed relationship arrows between packages, filter out packages below a configurable minimum entity count, produce deterministic output for the same input graph, and support standalone export to .puml files.

nodes.name: Diagram Generation Operation
nodes.description: The Architecture Diagram Generator exposes a generate_diagram operation that accepts min_entity_count (int, default 1) and an optional output_path (str). On success, it returns the PlantUML component diagram as a string. On Neo4j query failure, it signals a DbQueryError error state. On file write failure (when output_path is provided), it signals a FileWriteError error state.

nodes.name: Codegraph Data Acquisition
nodes.description: The generate_diagram operation shall query the Neo4j codegraph (via the existing LayerGraph infrastructure) to retrieve all ModuleNode and NamespaceNode instances, their composition relationships with class-like nodes (ClassNode, InterfaceNode, EnumNode), and their inter-package dependency/relationship links.

nodes.name: Package Rendering with Class Detail
nodes.description: The generated PlantUML diagram shall render each namespace/module as a PlantUML package block (package "Name" { ... }) containing its composed class-like nodes (classes, interfaces, enums) at medium detail level — showing the element name and its PlantUML stereotype keyword (e.g., 'class', 'interface', 'enum') but excluding internal members like attributes and methods.

nodes.name: Directed Relationship Arrow Rendering
nodes.description: The generated PlantUML diagram shall render directed dependency arrows between package blocks for each inter-package relationship retrieved from Neo4j. Each arrow uses PlantUML component-diagram syntax: [SourcePackage] -[#style]-> [TargetPackage]. The direction follows the relationship direction from the codegraph.

nodes.name: Configurable Entity Count Filter
nodes.description: The generate_diagram operation shall filter out packages whose entity count (number of class-like nodes composed within the namespace/module) is strictly less than the configured min_entity_count parameter. Packages meeting or exceeding the threshold are included. A filtered package and its relationships are entirely omitted from the output.

nodes.name: Deterministic Output Ordering
nodes.description: The generate_diagram operation shall produce deterministic output: packages are ordered alphabetically by name, class-like elements within each package are ordered alphabetically by name, and relationship arrows are ordered alphabetically by source package name then target package name. The same input graph always produces byte-identical PlantUML output.

nodes.name: Standalone File Export
nodes.description: When the output_path parameter is provided to generate_diagram, the generated PlantUML content shall be written to the specified file path as a .puml file. The file shall contain only the PlantUML diagram content (UTF-8 encoded) with no additional wrapping. On write failure (permission denied, invalid path), the operation returns a FileWriteError error state and does not return the diagram string.
